name: RS Q3
description: The Audi RS Q3 (2013–present) is the performance variant of the Q3, using the 2.5-litre five-cylinder turbocharged engine from the RS3. It is the definitive compact performance crossover, with 340–400 hp and quattro AWD in an elevated SUV body.
